technical_quality: Adequate: PA projection with R marker at image top-left (patient right), adequate inspiration (~9-10 posterior ribs), minimal rotation, adequate penetration (spine visible through the heart). Scapulae partly overlap the upper lateral lung fields; no cut-off of costophrenic angles.

devices.type: Implanted venous access port (port-a-cath) reservoir with catheter
devices.location: Reservoir in the right anterior upper chest wall (patient right upper zone, image left, below the right clavicle); catheter loops cranially over the right clavicle (right internal jugular approach) and descends along the right mediastinal border in the SVC, tip projecting near the cavoatrial junction / upper right atrium
Image top-left corner, over the patient's right shoulder

abnormalities.finding: Ill-defined mass-like opacity (~4 x 3.5 cm), medial/infrahilar, abutting the right heart border; mass vs. mass-like consolidation
Bulky, lobulated left hilum / perihilar mass (~3.5 cm), suspicious for hilar mass or hilar lymphadenopathy
Well-defined round nodule (~1.5-2 cm) lateral to the left hilum
Prominent / widened left mediastinal contour from the aortic arch level downward (AP window appears filled), possible mediastinal lymphadenopathy vs. tortuous aorta
No pleural effusion, no pneumothorax; costophrenic angles sharp; cardiothoracic ratio within normal limits; no rib fracture or lytic lesion identified

description_zh: PA 胸部X光，右前上胸壁可見植入式靜脈注射座 (port-a-cath)，導管經右側頸內靜脈路徑沿右縱膈緣下行至上腔靜脈，末端約位於上腔靜脈與右心房交界處。左側肺門腫大且呈分葉狀 (約 3.5 cm)，其外側左肺中野另見一邊界清楚之圓形結節 (約 1.5-2 cm)，左側縱膈輪廓亦較寬；右肺中下野內側 (肺門下方、緊鄰右心緣) 可見一邊界不清之腫塊樣陰影 (約 4 cm)，腫塊或實質化病灶需鑑別。兩側肋膈角銳利，未見肋膜積液或氣胸，心臟大小正常；無胸管或引流管，但植入式注射座提示病人可能已接受或正在接受全身性治療。
